draft_en.subject: PoE switches for Dante / AES67 and AV-over-IP installations
draft_en.body:
Hello Standard Audio team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 18 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches your integrators specify with Dante / AES67 audio and AV-over-IP, two L2+ managed units with IGMP snooping and QoS, Marvell-based, neutral packing, CE/RoHS, from small lots: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5. Voice-evacuation loops stay with your EN54 systems - we only do the Ethernet side.

One question: which port count do your integrators use most in meeting rooms - 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
